title: AedesCapella
shortDescription: An acoustic mosquito detection thesis with on-device machine learning and an operator dashboard for sensor status, candidate activity, and relay logs.
role: Thesis development: acoustic sensing, on-device model, and monitoring dashboard.
problem: Manual mosquito monitoring provides limited visibility into activity around a device. AedesCapella explores acoustic sensing and automatic response as an alternative.
approach: An ESP32-S3 processes wingbeat audio with an on-device 1D-CNN. A React dashboard displays sensor health, activity charts, mapped devices, and placement comparisons. Supabase provides operator authentication and live data, with polling to recover missed updates.
challenges: Separating device health from dashboard connectivity and showing stale or incomplete data clearly. Model candidates are not biologically confirmed detections, and recorded relay commands do not verify fluid delivery.
imageAlt: AedesCapella public sign-in screen for authorized dashboard operators
demoNote: An operator account is required. The screenshot shows the public sign-in page.
coverImageAlt: AedesCapella public sign-in screen for authorized dashboard operators

title: Pickle Batangas
shortDescription: A Batangas pickleball court finder with map search, venue comparisons, saved shortlists, and shareable game plans.
problem: Players need to compare court locations, hours, and amenities before organizing a game.
approach: Built a React PWA with a searchable directory and synchronized Leaflet map. Players can compare three venues, share saved shortlists, and create game invitations with calendar export. Plans validate future times against court opening hours; favorites persist across browser tabs.
challenges: Keeping map and directory filters consistent, validating opening windows, and making search and map controls usable on phones.
demoNote: Invitations do not reserve courts or take payment. Venue illustrations are labeled; maps and live weather require a connection.
imageAlt: Pickle Batangas live homepage with court search and an illustrated pickleball court

title: Momento
shortDescription: An installable photobooth app for single photos and photo strips, with editing, export, and a gallery stored on the device.
role: Sole developer: interface, camera flow, photo editor, and offline storage.
problem: A portable photobooth needs to capture, edit, and keep photos without depending on a continuous connection.
approach: Built a React PWA with timed capture, per-shot retakes, filters, stickers, and frames. Photos can be downloaded or shared, while IndexedDB keeps a local gallery with pinning, sorting, and deletion controls.
challenges: Managing camera permissions and device storage while preserving the capture and editing flow offline.
imageAlt: Momento photobooth welcome screen with photo capture and gallery actions

title: MedTech Mate
shortDescription: A MedTech internship workspace for rotations, procedure quotas, shifts, notes, and documents, with Chami as an AI study companion.
role: Sole developer: internship workspace, data integration, and Chami study chat.
problem: Medical technology interns need one place to track clinical requirements, schedules, and reference materials.
approach: Built a responsive React workspace backed by account-scoped Supabase records. Procedure logs update quota progress, calendars organize shifts and exams, and search connects saved notes and documents. Chami answers study questions through an authenticated Groq endpoint.
challenges: Preventing duplicate quota counts, handling local calendar dates, and keeping account data and mobile forms consistent across the app.
imageAlt: MedTech Mate live landing page with internship planning, quota progress, rotation, and shift previews
demoNote: The screenshot shows illustrative sample data on the public landing page. The workspace and study chat require an account.

title: Daymargin
shortDescription: A daily organizer for notes, tasks, schedules, and expenses, with cloud sync, offline access, and Finn as an AI companion.
role: Personal project: application development, offline sync, account integration, and Finn chat.
problem: Daily plans, notes, and spending often live in separate apps. Daymargin combines them with Philippine peso amounts and Manila calendar dates.
approach: Built a React PWA with Today, Calendar, Library, and Finn views. IndexedDB preserves account records and drafts offline; authenticated Neon Postgres endpoints synchronize queued edits with conflict review. Finn can reference permitted records and propose changes for the user to confirm.
challenges: Keeping drafts safe across reloads, resolving offline edits without overwriting newer cloud records, and limiting AI access to permitted data.
imageAlt: Daymargin public welcome page with its daily organizer illustration, Philippine peso expense, and Finn dog companion
demoNote: The screenshot shows the public welcome page. Cloud sync and Finn chat use an account. Scheduled background reminders are still in progress.

title: Pocket Quest
shortDescription: A task journal that turns completed work into coins and XP, with animated companions, a customizable habitat, focus timers, and AI chat.
role: Personal project: task and reward system, companion interactions, cloud saves, and chat.
problem: Task lists can make small daily achievements easy to overlook. Pocket Quest connects completed tasks with visible progress and companion care.
approach: Built a React PWA with recurring tasks, effort-based rewards, six animated companions, and a habitat shop. Neon Auth and Postgres save account progress. An ordered offline queue retries changes safely and rolls back rejected actions. Groq provides separate conversations and memory for each companion.
challenges: Keeping rewards and purchases consistent during rapid or offline actions, preserving queued saves across reloads, and supporting accessible phone layouts and reduced motion.
imageAlt: Pocket Quest repository preview of the dark Today screen with Finn, a pixel habitat, task rewards, and focus controls
demoNote: The repository preview uses sample progress. An account is required. Cached progress works offline; companion chat requires a connection.

title: Pinoy Recipe Finder
shortDescription: A Filipino recipe library with dish search, category filters, cooking instructions, and saved favorites.
problem: Home cooks need ingredients and cooking steps in one place, with a quick way to find familiar Filipino dishes.
approach: Built a React recipe library with photo cards, name and category search, detailed ingredients and instructions, and a dedicated favorites view.
imageAlt: Pinoy Recipe Finder homepage showing Filipino dishes, search, category filters, and recipe cards

title: StudySpot PH
shortDescription: A Philippine study-space directory with location and price filters, venue details, and a demo booking flow.
problem: Students and remote workers need to compare study spaces by location, price, and amenities.
approach: Built a React directory for cafés, coworking spaces, and study hubs. Search, sorting, and price filters narrow the options; detail pages connect venue information to a demo reservation flow.
imageAlt: StudySpot PH homepage with space search, price filters, and café illustration

title: C4A Fieldnotes
shortDescription: A campus event planner for De La Salle Lipa C4A students, with live updates, saved events, a calendar, and officer administration.
problem: Students need a shared view of section events and deadlines. Officers need a controlled way to keep those details current.
approach: Built a React planner with searchable events, local bookmarks, and Manila-time calendar exports. Supabase manages authentication, event storage, and live updates. Officers can create, edit, duplicate, and delete events through a responsive administration workspace.
imageAlt: C4A Fieldnotes live overview with forest-green navigation, a section noticeboard, and a weekly event preview
challenges: Keeping student views current after officer edits and making calendars, event dialogs, and management tables work on small screens.

title: Eventure
shortDescription: A campus event app for discovering events, saving favorites, and managing registrations.
role: Team project: booking flow and form validation.
problem: Students need clear feedback while entering event booking details, before reaching the final submission step.
approach: The React Native app uses Expo and Supabase for accounts, event discovery, saved events, and booking history. My contribution focused on the booking flow and input validation.
demoNote: The supplied screenshot shows the welcome screen. Its displayed activity figures are interface copy, not verified usage metrics.
imageAlt: Eventure welcome screen with campus event discovery and sign-in, account creation, and guest browsing actions

title: Job Finder
shortDescription: A mobile job browser with live listings, search and filters, saved jobs, and local application tracking.
problem: Job seekers need a way to compare listings, keep a shortlist, and track the roles they have applied for.
approach: Loads listings from the Empllo API and normalizes company, location, salary, and application-link data. Search and filters narrow the results. AsyncStorage keeps saved listings and application records for each local user, with a validated application form.
challenges: Handling missing salary data, generating stable listing IDs, and keeping saved jobs and application records associated with the current user.
demoNote: Listings come from Empllo. Sign-in and application tracking are local demo flows; submitting the in-app form does not send an application to an employer.
imageAlt: Job Finder mobile search screen showing Empllo listings, company information, salary ranges, and saved and applied job tabs

title: Online Ordering System
shortDescription: A mobile product catalog with search, price filters, a quantity-aware cart, and a validated demo checkout.
problem: Shoppers need to find products, adjust quantities, and understand the total before confirming an order.
approach: Built a typed React Native shopping flow with product details, search, sorting, and price filters. Shared cart state handles quantities and selected items. Checkout validates delivery details and payment selection, then calculates shipping and tax before a simulated confirmation.
challenges: Keeping selected-item totals consistent with quantity changes and preventing the same checkout from being confirmed twice.
demoNote: Checkout simulates order confirmation. No payment is collected or order sent to a server. The cart is held in memory for the current app session.
imageAlt: Online Ordering System dark product catalog with search, filters, a cart action, and product cards with Philippine peso prices

title: IRIS QA Testing
shortDescription: Team-based quality assurance for the IRIS intrusion-recognition application, with test scenarios, execution results, and documented findings.
role: QA tester on the evaluation team: test design, execution, and results documentation.
problem: The IRIS application needed evaluation across account access, device pairing, monitoring, recognition, and administrative workflows.
approach: Designed manual test cases using boundary values, valid and invalid input classes, and positive and negative scenarios. The team workbook records unit, integration, and system tests with steps, expected results, actual results, status, and comments.
challenges: Covering role permissions, unavailable devices and camera feeds, failed requests, recognition conditions, and complete user workflows across the mobile app and web administration screens.
outcome: Delivered a shared QA workbook with traceable test scenarios and recorded findings for review by the development team.

evidence.title: IRIS QA workbook
evidence.description: Shared scenarios, test steps, expected and actual results, and findings for the IRIS application.
evidence.summary: Team workbook: 157 passed and 2 failed cases.

title: King Ace Trading
shortDescription: A demand forecasting capstone using historical sales and linear regression for a school supply distributor.
problem: King Ace Trading needed a clearer basis for inventory planning, balancing excess stock against shortages.
approach: Used linear regression on historical sales to estimate future demand. Presented the analysis, method, and forecasts in a formal capstone defense.

title: Travel Diary
shortDescription: An Expo travel journal that saves photos, locations, and personal notes locally on the device.
role: Sole developer: mobile interface and local entry storage.
problem: Travel photos and notes often lose the context of where they were taken. A journal keeps the place and story together.
approach: Built with React Native, Expo, and TypeScript. Entries combine camera or gallery photos, location details, and notes, with AsyncStorage for local persistence.
imageAlt: Travel Diary dark homepage with journal statistics, an empty memory collection, and a New Memory action

title: Node-RED Analytics Dashboard
shortDescription: A smaller analytics dashboard built with Node-RED.
role: Sole developer — built the flows and dashboard.
approach: Built using Node-RED's visual flow editor to wire together data sources and a dashboard without a traditional hand-coded backend.
